title: Dating App Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your personal data from Tinder, Bumble, Grindr and other dating apps. Protect your privacy with our GDPR-compliant letter.
description: A comprehensive letter template to request your personal data from dating apps like Tinder, Bumble, and Grindr. Includes GDPR and CCPA compliant language to help you understand what data these platforms collect about you.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Recipient Information
sections.content:
Date: [DATE]

To: Data Protection Officer
[DATING_APP_COMPANY]
[COMPANY_ADDRESS]

Subject: Request for Personal Data Under Data Protection Laws

Dear Data Protection Team,

sections.heading: Personal Information and Account Details
sections.content:
I am writing to request access to my personal data that your company processes. My account details are as follows:

Full Name: [FULL_NAME]
Email Address: [EMAIL_ADDRESS]
Phone Number: [PHONE_NUMBER]
Account Username/ID: [USERNAME]
Approximate Account Creation Date: [CREATION_DATE]

sections.heading: Specific Data Categories Requested
sections.content:
Under applicable data protection laws (GDPR Article 15, CCPA Section 1798.110), I request access to all personal data you process about me, including but not limited to:

• Profile information (photos, bio, preferences)
• Location data and geolocation history
• Match history and interaction data
• Messages and communication records
• Payment and subscription information
• Device information and app usage analytics
• Data obtained from third-party sources
• Any automated decision-making or profiling data

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Rights
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights as a data subject under [APPLICABLE_LAW]. I understand that you are required to respond to this request within [RESPONSE_TIME] of receipt. Please provide the data in a commonly used electronic format.

If you need additional information to verify my identity, please contact me using the details provided above.

placeholders.label: Applicable Privacy Law
placeholders.defaultValue: GDPR and applicable local data protection laws

sections.heading: Data Processing Transparency Request
sections.content:
Additionally, please provide information about:

• The purposes for which my personal data is processed
• Categories of recipients with whom my data has been shared
• Data retention periods for different types of information
• Your legal basis for processing my personal data
• Any transfers of my data to third countries or international organizations
• The source of personal data not collected directly from me

sections.heading: Closing and Contact Information
sections.content:
I look forward to your prompt response within the legally required timeframe. Should you have any questions regarding this request, please contact me at [CONTACT_EMAIL] or [CONTACT_PHONE].

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[SIGNATURE]
[PRINTED_NAME]
[DATE_SIGNED]
